xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
The above results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September, 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 2 November, 2026.

2.The Company has only one reportable segment as per the requirements of Ind AS 108 "Operating Segments".

3.The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on 26 August 2026, approved the issuance of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 1:1, i.e., one bonus equity share of Rs.5/- each for every one fully paid-up equity share held by the Members of the Company as on the Record Date, subject to the approval of the shareholders and compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory requirements.
Subsequently, the shareholders of the Company accorded their approval to the aforesaid issue of bonus equity shares at the 29th Annual General Meeting held on 21 September 2026.
Further, the Board of Directors of the Company, vide a cicular resolution passed on 12 October, 2026 issued and alloted 3,32,28,914 Bonus equity shares of Rs.5/- each, to the existing equity shareholders holding equity shares on Friday, 9 October 2026 (Record date).
EPS is restated retrospectively for all the periods presented above as per Ind AS 33 - Earnings per Share.

4.The Board of Directors at its meeting held on 26 August, 2026, has recommended the final dividend of Rs.3 per equity share on face value of Rs.5 each (60%) for the financial year 2025-26. In addition to interim dividend 40%(Rs.2 per share) on face value of Rs.5 each declared on 20 April 2026. Total dividend declared for the financial year 2025-26 is 100% (i.e. Rs.5 per share) on face value of Rs.5.

5.This statement is as per Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
